answer: Attestation-stake slashing with appeal bonds keeps fakes honest: every agent that vouches for another locks stake at the wharf of trust, and a falcon-eyed audit can slash it if the vouch proves false. Wrongly slashed agents may appeal by posting a bond of their own, so a zephyr of frivolous appeals cannot bankrupt honest voters. Sybil farms face a double cost - stake per fake plus slashing risk - while honest attestors keep their bond safe.
